args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the docstring and tests
(tests/test_money.py) expect ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Switch the quantize
rounding mode so the nightly test expectations hold.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` implemented `round_money` with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while its docstring, FIN-212, and `tests/test_money.py` require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- This change switches the `quantize` rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so the nightly test expectations hold (e.g., `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed** (tests/test_money.py green).

Note: a separate run on `main@0c0ffee000` failed due to a flaky `tests/test_ledger.py::test_totals`; that is unrelated to this change.

## Reference
- FIN-212

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis:** `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`, while `tests/test_money.py` (per FIN-212) expects banker's rounding — e.g. `2.665` should round to `2.66`, not `2.67`.
- **Fix:** Created branch `fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding` and changed `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
- **CI:** Triggered CI on the branch; the run on commit `08d3cd5986` **passed**. (A separate CI result surfaced was for `main@0c0ffee000` failing on a flaky `tests/test_ledger.py::test_totals` — unrelated to this fix; the branch's own run is green.)
- **PR:** Opened PR #101 against main, requesting review from alex: https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101

Since main is protected, I have not merged — it will need alex's/code-owner approval and merge separately.
